::: {.document-meta}
Master's thesis · 2026 · Supervisor: Sofia Tirabassi
:::

This thesis follows Part I of Aaron Mazel-Gee's *Higher Algebra: Chapter 0*, developing homological algebra towards the derived ∞-category of $R$-modules.

The topics include chain complexes, homotopies, quasi-isomorphisms, homotopy kernels and cokernels, resolutions, dg-categories and a first introduction to ∞-categories.
